name: KingbaseES
minimum_privileges: USAGE AND CREATE ON TEST SCHEMA

privilege_checks.privilege: USAGE AND CREATE ON TEST SCHEMA

qualification.scope: Official platform integration only for observed server V009R002C016, database_mode=oracle, JDBC database version 12.1, driver V008R006B0001 and the recorded artifact SHA-256. The 2026-10-19 FULL task has 270 terminal result records: 261 contracts invoked and nine not invoked due to missing or blocked preparation (four direct, five blocked); 252 passed, nine failed, nine aborted, with successful cleanup. Other combinations are unvalidated. See docs/execution-safety.md#kingbasees-platform-validation.
qualification.timeout_note: The initial 90-second CORE exploration timed out. Subsequent FULL execution completed in 423.4 seconds; this does not erase the historical timeout or claim that all JDBC tests passed.
qualification.capability_policy: Historical declarations only; false does not disable standard JDBC tests. Actual contract outcomes and missing prerequisites remain separate from adapter maturity.
qualification.asset_policy: Kingbase uses isolated copies of the existing PostgreSQL baseline plus four Kingbase-specific procedure/REF cursor/ROWID/multiple-result fixtures. The 2026-10-19 targeted follow-up independently invoked all nine historical preparation-blocked contracts and repeated them in one nine-case task: eight conforming and one result-sequence update-count assertion failure, with successful owned-object cleanup. Four direct preparation gaps and five shared blockers are resolved; the remaining assertion is a separate open follow-up. This supplements, rather than rewrites, the historical FULL results and remains limited to the same recorded build/mode/driver combination.
qualification.version_policy: Only the recorded build/mode/artifact is validated. Existing numeric version ranges remain unset because they cannot express the Kingbase build and driver declaration; no all-version support is implied and build/mode are not runtime-enforced.
qualification.result_review: Retain the nine original failures and nine aborts. XA prepare failures with max_prepared_transactions=0 are environment limitations. LOB, DataSource logWriter, REF metadata, indexed batch keys and holdability observations remain visible with the review boundaries in the evidence record.
